dct_description_sm: The Victoria Water Monitoring Program is a Swim Drink Fish Canada community-science initiative that was launched in summer 2023. Operating out of Prospect Lake, The Victoria Hub is a partnership between Swim Drink Fish and Power To Be. It engages the community in water quality monitoring and data-sharing, as well as stewardship of local waters.
dct_title_s: Swim Drink Fish- Power to Be Victoria Hub Water Quality Monitoring
